approval: Owner approved section 1 and the Original Circuit seam repair on 18 November 2026.

checks.rule: Road corners and wall endpoints exactly match the pinned source
checks.input: Hash every double-precision road corner and rail endpoint, without rounding.
checks.expected: Both SHA256 digests equal the independent source capture.

checks.rule: Road width, height and triangle data are finite and nondegenerate
checks.input: Visit every road segment and its four corners.
checks.expected: Asphalt is 26 m wide, each curb is 1.1 m, total is 28.2 m; both triangle areas are positive.

checks.rule: Centerline joins close and distance sampling wraps consistently
checks.input: Compare every consecutive centerline endpoint and sample negative, zero and multi-lap distances.
checks.expected: Zero centerline gap; identical wrapped positions to 0.00000001 m; sample(0) is the original start.

checks.rule: Every road segment supports interior probes along its length
checks.input: Probe each segment at t=0, 0.5 and 0.999 and at 2%, 50% and 98% across its four-corner strip.
checks.expected: Every one of the scripted strip-interior points has road support below its interpolated height + 0.65 m.

checks.rule: Road-height queries match independently captured source results
checks.input: Probe source segments every 19 samples at five lateral positions and a maximum height of road + 0.65 m.
checks.expected: Every supported height matches to 0.00000001 m; every empty result agrees.

checks.rule: Bridge crossings keep their lower and upper road surfaces separate
checks.input: At every source centerline crossing separated by at least 4 m, query below and above the upper deck.
checks.expected: Both source heights match; the lower query never jumps to the upper deck.

checks.rule: All 13 gates retain their source positions, directions and order
checks.input: Read each source gate and map its source station onto the physical polyline.
checks.expected: 13 gates; zero position/direction error; strictly increasing physical distances starting at 0.

checks.rule: Directed gate sweeps agree at 30, 60, 120 and 144 FPS
checks.input: At each FPS, move a point at 180 mph straight through every gate for two seconds. Also sweep backward, too high and outside the gate. No vehicle simulation is used.
checks.expected: One forward crossing per gate at t=1 s, identical hit points and times at every FPS; zero invalid crossings.

checks.rule: Road, access bridge and intentional wall openings stay distinct
checks.input: Check the access bridge center and far-away empty space, then query every wall midpoint.
checks.expected: Bridge supports its source height; empty space has no floor; all rail midpoints are found on their own deck.

checks.rule: A translated and rotated island placement preserves road geometry
checks.input: Translate by (1234,70,-890) m and rotate by 0.7 radians; sample 60 locations around the loop.
checks.expected: Sample positions, road heights and projection distances agree after the same transform; no voxel-grid rounding.

checks.rule: Projection can stay on the intended route at a crossing
checks.input: Project each crossing position with separate hints for its two source segments.
checks.expected: Both branch hints return their own segment and height; a tiny impossible progress window returns null.

checks.rule: Approved seam weld closes only the source seam
checks.input: Compare reference mode against the approved default seam weld.
checks.expected: Welded edge gap is zero; route length, centerline and every gate stay unchanged. Maximum edit is under 5 cm.
